title: Netgear GS108LP 8-Port Gigabit PoE Unmanaged Rackmount Switch (PoE Budget 60W)

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Netgear GS108LP 8-Port Gigabit PoE Unmanaged Rackmount Switch is a compact, powerful, and reliable networking solution designed for small offices, CCTV systems, IP cameras, VoIP phones, and Wi-Fi access points. With a 60W PoE power budget, this switch delivers both data and power through a single Ethernet cable, reducing installation cost and cable clutter.


Its plug-and-play unmanaged design, fanless silent operation, and durable metal chassis make it an ideal choice for professional and commercial networking environments in Bangladesh.


Key Features:


  • 8 x Gigabit Ethernet Ports (10/100/1000 Mbps)
    High-speed wired connectivity for network devices.

  • PoE+ Support (IEEE 802.3af / 802.3at)
    All ports support PoE to power compatible devices directly.

  • 60W Total PoE Power Budget
    Ideal for powering IP cameras, Wi-Fi access points, and VoIP phones.

  • Unmanaged Plug-and-Play Switch
    No configuration or software required — connect and start instantly.

  • Rackmount, Wall & Desktop Installation
    Flexible mounting options for offices and server racks.

  • Silent Fanless Design
    Noise-free operation for quiet environments.

  • Metal Housing
    Strong, durable build for long-term professional use.

  • Energy Efficient Ethernet (IEEE 802.3az)
    Reduces power consumption and operating costs.

  • Auto-Negotiation & Auto-MDI/MDIX
    Automatically detects speed and cable type — no crossover cables needed.
